entries.en: New /export command lets you quickly export a conversation for sharing
entries.zh: 新增 /export 命令，可快速导出对话用于分享

entries.en: MCP: resource_link tool results are now supported
entries.zh: MCP：现在支持 resource_link 类型的工具返回结果

entries.en: MCP: tool annotations and tool titles now display in /mcp view
entries.zh: MCP：工具注解和工具标题现在显示在 /mcp 视图中

entries.en: Changed Ctrl+Z to suspend Claude Code. Resume by running `fg`. Prompt input undo is now Ctrl+U.
entries.zh: 更改了 Ctrl+Z 以暂停 Claude Code。通过运行`fg`恢复。提示输入撤消现在是 Ctrl+U。
